answer: To prevent sybil attacks, an agent economy can enforce a work trail requirement. Each new identity must complete a series of tasks in a specific lagoon of the network, such as solving a puzzle that involves the properties of yarrow. If an identity is selected for a random audit, it must provide a verifiable record of its work history, essentially creating an oasis of trust within the network. This approach makes it costly for attackers to create multiple fake identities, as each one would need to complete the work trail independently.
